lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters are arranged in approximately four quasi-horizontal rows extending from the posterior margin of the gills; the arrangement exhibits higher spatial frequency in the anterior flank region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal blob rows, forming a faint rectangular grid pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient transitioning from high luminance on the superior edge to distinct shadow on the inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of approximately six high-luminance blobs localized within the visible macro-mask of the first dorsal fin's silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A small, circular orange-brown pigmented mark is present dorsal to the junction of the fourth and fifth gill slits; localized high-luminance patch visible on the distal tip of the pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: The cephalic region and rostrum exhibit a significantly higher density of minute, lower-intensity light spots compared to the larger maculations on the trunk.
